newsitem.title: MACAU: Police arrest man in gruesome Macau murder case.
newsitem.headline: Police arrest man in gruesome Macau murder case.

text.p: Police in China have arrested a man suspected of dismembering two prostitutes in a bathtub at a Macau hotel in June, police in Macau said on Wednesday.
The suspect, surnamed Song, was arrested in China's Jilin province last week, police said.
Song, 31, was expected to arrive in China's Zhuhai city, neighbouring the Portuguese-run enclave of Macau, later this week for questioning, they added.

Workers stumbled on the dismembered body parts -- three manicured fingers and several internal organs -- in a sewer at the Hotel President in mid June. Two female heads were also found by construction workers nearby, police said.
